ns2:course.label: Language Literacy in Early Childhood Education II
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes developmentally appropriate practices for the teaching of reading and writing in grades K-2. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CI 465. Requires concurrent enrollment in CI 420 and CI 443.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CI 465. Requires concurrent enrollment in CI 420 and CI 443.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Special Education or Early Childhood Education or Early Childhood Education major(s) or minor(s).
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Admitted Teacher Ed Student students.
